No p value or posthoc role inference from rank.
content: Fixed whole-word set chedy/shedy/chey/cheol from v63, not inferred ingredients. Paragraph P only. Count daiin and candidate content per source line, uncertain slots retained. Residual slope within exact page x total slot length x unknown-slot count blocks. Permute content counts within blocks 999 times, one-sided positive prediction. >=20 movable lines and >=3 contributing folios. Bonferroni over all estimated eligible H/F strata. Preserve negative slopes and unsupported strata.
qualification: Synthetic nuisance and positive-control engineering check before manuscript scoring; not independent known-text semantic qualification. No new role assignment. Existing known-text role gate remains closed.
rebus: Supplied anomaly percentages unverified. Template irregularity, repeated rare groups and initial-sign deletion cannot identify phonetic encoding. Need training-defined templates, held-out controls for length/frequency/hand/format/position and reading ambiguity, plus independently anchored readings to support phonetics.
